bad.title: Copied for a quarter second
bad.text: People looking back from the click see Copy link again, as if nothing happened.

bad.title: Pressed again, just to be sure
bad.text: The flash left people unsure, so the count of presses climbs.
bad.wait: Press Copy link twice to see this.

good.title: A check and Copied, on the button
good.text: It stays long enough to see after people look back from the click.
good.wait: Press Copy link to see this.

bad.title: The button looks untouched
bad.text: Add to cart reads the same after the click, right where people are looking.

bad.title: The only sign is far away
bad.text: Cart 0 turns to 1 in the corner, which few people watch.

bad.title: Two headphones by accident
bad.text: People press again to be sure and end up with 2 in the cart.
bad.wait: Press Add to cart twice to see this.

good.title: Added, on the button itself
good.text: The answer shows where people clicked, then it reads Add another.
good.wait: Press Add to cart to see this.

good.title: The cart count changes too
good.text: A second sign, for people who check the cart before paying.

bad.title: A toast for every tick
bad.text: Three ticks stack three identical Task updated toasts, each for six seconds.
bad.wait: Tick three tasks to see this.

bad.title: The share notice gets lost
bad.text: “Sam can edit it” lands at the bottom of the pile, easy to skip.
bad.wait: Tick three tasks, then press Share with Sam to see this.

good.title: A tick only changes the task
good.text: The box fills and the line strikes through, which is answer enough.

good.title: One toast, for the share
good.text: “List shared with Sam. Sam can edit it.” stands alone, so people read it.
good.wait: Press Share with Sam to see this.

bad.title: Post looks idle while it works
bad.text: For over a second nothing changes, so people press again.

bad.title: The same comment, twice
bad.text: The second press posted Lovely with extra basil again, outlined in red.
bad.wait: Press Post twice to see this.

good.title: Posting… with a spinner
good.text: The button answers at once, so there’s no reason to press again.
good.wait: Press Post to see this.

good.title: Extra clicks do nothing
good.text: Still posting. The extra click was ignored. One comment goes up.
good.wait: Press Post twice to see this.

bad.title: The heart stays filled
bad.text: Nothing says the save failed, so people trust it and move on.
bad.wait: Tap the heart on the lamp to see this.

bad.title: Missing after Reload
bad.text: Desk lamp was never saved. People find out when they come back for it.
bad.wait: Tap the heart on the lamp, then press Reload to see this.

good.title: The heart empties on the lamp
good.text: The rollback shows on the item people tapped, with a brief highlight.
good.wait: Tap the heart on the lamp and wait a moment to see this.

good.title: Says what failed, offers Retry
good.text: Couldn’t save Desk lamp. No connection. Screen readers announce it too.
good.wait: Tap the heart on the lamp and wait a moment to see this.

bad.title: Paid before the bank answers
bad.text: “Paid. Enjoy the show” shows at once, so people may close the app.

bad.title: Then it takes it back
bad.text: A moment later it says declined, which people who looked away never see.
bad.wait: Press Pay and wait two seconds to see this.

good.title: Paying… until the bank answers
good.text: No result shows until there is one.
good.wait: Press Pay to see this.

good.title: One answer, and it holds
good.text: Declined. You weren’t charged. The button turns into Try another card.
good.wait: Press Pay and wait two seconds to see this.

bad.title: Answers come back out of order
bad.text: Answer 2 arrives first, then the slow answer 1 flips the switch back.
bad.wait: Click the switch twice quickly and wait two seconds to see this.

bad.title: The switch says On, the server Off
bad.text: People see On after choosing Off, and can’t tell what others see.
bad.wait: Click the switch twice quickly and wait two seconds to see this.

good.title: Old answers are ignored
good.text: Answer 1 is old. Ignored. Only request 2 decides what’s shown.
good.wait: Click the switch twice quickly and wait two seconds to see this.

good.title: Switch and server agree
good.text: Both say Off, the choice people made last.
good.wait: Click the switch twice quickly and wait two seconds to see this.

bad.title: Progress lives on the Map screen
bad.text: The bar sits inside the screen people are about to leave.

bad.title: Trips and Saved show nothing
bad.text: Open either one and there’s no sign the 120 MB map is still coming.

good.title: Map 42% in the top bar
good.text: It stays on Map, Trips and Saved, so people can check from anywhere.
good.wait: Press Download to see this.

good.title: Map ready, then it clears

good.wait: Press Download and wait about eight seconds to see this.

bad.title: Three seconds to press Open

good.title: The same quick toast
